citation.title: ICBC UnionPay Dual Currency Credit Card

extra.description: With the unique ability to handle two currencies, the ICBC UnionPay Dual Currency Credit Card offers unparalleled convenience and flexibility while traveling or shopping internationally. Seamlessly manage payments in both SGD and USD, while earning cashback on your purchases.
